candidate.source_summary: Request parameters from request.args (user-controlled HTTP request data) are directly copied into substitutions dictionary
candidate.sink_summary: Substitutions are used in email template formatting via string interpolation (line 56 in emailutils.py) and sent via SMTP
candidate.guard_summary: Limited filtering: only single-value string parameters are included. HTML escaping is applied in emailutils.py line 53 via cgi.escape for *_forhtml variables
candidate.risk_pattern: User-controlled request parameters are directly interpolated into email templates without validation, though HTML escaping is applied for specific template variables
candidate.context_summary: Request parameters are collected into substitutions dictionary for email invitation template. The email template system applies HTML escaping to variables with _forhtml suffix and URL encoding to variables with _forurl suffix
unresolved_facts: Specific email template content and usage patterns
Whether all template variables that use raw substitutions are properly escaped
Configuration of email template file location and content

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
target_cwe.description: The product constructs all or part of a command, data structure, or record using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify how it is parsed or interpreted when it is sent to a downstream component. Common in: input_validation.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting
